## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#80`
- **Variant Name**: `DisputeActive`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `WARNING`
- **Retryable**: `Yes`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::CancelDuringDispute` — an open dispute freezes cancel_stream.
- `Branch::TopUpDuringDispute` — an open dispute freezes top_up.
- `Branch::RaiseDisputeAlreadyActive` — raise_dispute called while a dispute is open.

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Resolve or expire the open dispute before cancelling, topping up, or raising another dispute; re-read the dispute overlay first.
>
